defaults.source: This study stage 4 pure local NOA baseline
defaults.rationale: Explicit generic controller development value, not branded NOA or a calibrated paper parameter. Hard, comfort, jerk, vehicle and sensing limits remain inherited without override.

parameters.name: noa_target_speed_mps
parameters.rationale: Generic nominal cruise speed shared with the previous probe development baseline.

parameters.name: noa_response_time_s
parameters.rationale: Fixed conservative planning response budget inherited from nominal 0.1s control plus 0.2s actuator lag. Held fixed in sampling studies so changing sampler does not also retune the policy envelope.

parameters.name: noa_lane_change_duration_s
parameters.rationale: Nominal finite duration for two quadratic Bezier segments; never a periodic lane-change trigger.

parameters.name: noa_prepare_duration_s
parameters.rationale: Require persistent observed motivation and a rechecked candidate before start.

parameters.name: noa_min_lane_change_speed_mps
parameters.rationale: Avoid initiating lateral maneuvers at near-zero kinematic speed.

parameters.name: noa_overtake_horizon_s
parameters.rationale: Only consider a slower lead within this nominal closing horizon plus following gap.

parameters.name: noa_merge_lookahead_s
parameters.rationale: Time-scaled local physical lane-end trigger, no global coordinate threshold.

parameters.name: noa_prediction_dt_s
parameters.rationale: Maximum candidate command/prediction slice; each slice integrates the unchanged kinematic model at <= its existing max dynamics dt and uses conservative swept geometry.

parameters.name: noa_prediction_settle_s
parameters.rationale: Include tracking settling after nominal reference end.

parameters.name: noa_body_margin_m
parameters.rationale: Geometric margin, not measurement noise; applied to both ego and predicted neighbor occupancy.

parameters.name: noa_prediction_lateral_accel_bound_mps2
parameters.rationale: Explicit limited prediction assumption: observed inertial lateral velocity remains constant. Longitudinal reachable range uses full inherited hard acceleration bounds and speed clipping. New unseen future lateral intent is not guaranteed safe.

parameters.name: noa_emergency_ttc_s
parameters.rationale: Closing-time emergency trigger used together with jerk-aware braking-gap feasibility.

parameters.name: noa_stop_release_speed_mps
parameters.rationale: Small positive deadband for stopped-lead holding, not a forced velocity snap.

parameters.name: noa_stop_capture_speed_mps
parameters.rationale: Begin terminal stopping early enough to taper actual acceleration before reaching zero speed; local stationary lead/end only, no global time trigger.

parameters.name: noa_stop_speed_gain_per_s
parameters.rationale: Terminal speed feedback. Together with the inherited 0.2s actuator lag this yields overdamped low-speed decay; verified in original fixed-duration cases.

parameters.name: noa_stop_terminal_braking_mps2
parameters.rationale: Finite weak terminal tail for actual integrated stop/hold. Actual jerk still audited at 0.01s and refined 0.005s; no state reset or replacement of actual jerk.

parameters.name: noa_stop_position_reserve_m
parameters.rationale: Place comfortable stopping target 3m upstream of the hard lane-end stopping screen, leaving terminal tracking error room. Development reserve equal to nominal standstill gap, not a global coordinate trigger or a relaxed hard boundary.

parameters.name: noa_stop_capture_gap_m
parameters.rationale: Base terminal stopping region, enlarged by headway times capture speed (total 17.4m). Fixed spatial region avoids releasing as speed falls; release remains based on current visible lead motion or geometry.
